blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Good corporate governance often works quietly in the background, guiding how decisions are made, risks are managed, and stakeholders are kept informed. Manila Water Company, Inc. received a Four-Arrow Award from the Institute of Corporate Directors at the 2026 Golden Arrow Awards, recognizing the company’s continuing efforts to uphold sound corporate governance practices.
